name: V_EHI_AUDIT_RT_HSB_ITEMS
description: This view contains audit information for document records for the purpose of Electronic Health Information (EHI) export. If not in the EHI context, RAD_THERAPY_AUDIT_INFO should be used instead.

columns.name: SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the episode of care record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: RAD_THERAPY_AUD_ITEM_LINE_NUM
columns.description: This item stores the item line that was updated.

columns.name: RAD_THERAPY_AUDIT_USER_ID
columns.description: Stores the user responsible for item update.

columns.name: RAD_THERAPY_AUDIT_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE_INTERNAL
columns.description: Contains the old value of the item in internal chronicles format.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE_INTERNAL
columns.description: Contains the new value of the item in internal chronicles format.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE_EXTERNAL
columns.description: Contains the old value of the item in external format.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE_EXTERNAL
columns.description: Contains the new value of the item in external format.

columns.name: CHANGED_DATA_ELEMENT
columns.description: The table and column descriptor associated with the item in the ITEM_NUMBER column.

columns.name: RAD_THERAPY_AUD_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: Stores the instant at which the item was updated.
